Tooltip_DelHeat_Pipe: Lies on the ground and carries the water. Laid one by one or as a run between two clicks. To cross a road in the air: build a floor one level up, lay the pipes on it and take the floor away. Right-click the ground: Heating. A pipe wrench is needed.
Tooltip_DelHeat_Radiator: Warms a room when a heat unit with hot water is within range. Needs no pipe of its own. Right-click the ground: Heating. A pipe wrench is needed.
Tooltip_DelHeat_Inlet: Stands at a wall of a house on the end of a pipe and feeds the radiators around it. Right-click the ground: Heating. A pipe wrench is needed.
Tooltip_DelHeat_Pump: Sends the water further along the pipe. Needs electricity. Right-click the ground: Heating. A pipe wrench is needed.
Tooltip_DelHeat_Intake: 2x2 cells by a river or a lake: pumps water into the pipes to a boiler house. Needs electricity. Right-click the ground: Heating. A pipe wrench is needed.
Tooltip_DelHeat_Boiler: 2x3 cells: burns fuel and heats the water for a whole neighbourhood. Right-click the ground: Heating. A pipe wrench is needed.
